claims.rationale: The interaction table states alcohol, through additive pharmacological effects, may increase psychomotor impairment or CNS depressant effects.

The phase 1 randomized crossover abstract states coadministration with alprazolam/ethanol increased the magnitude but not the duration of cognitive effects versus single agents, and separately reports worsened decline with ethanol.
The same trial abstract states no pharmacokinetic interactions were observed.
